title: KeyProfiles
description: Multiple keybind profiles for Minecraft players
body:
🎮 KeyProfiles

«Simple and fast keybind profile manager for Minecraft.»

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ZLzr2evR/images/4c764627fb9d48eb8399093a24948c03117ab28b.png)
---

📖 Overview

KeyProfiles lets you create, save, and switch between multiple keybind setups instantly — without opening the Controls menu every time.

---

✨ Features

- Create and manage multiple keybind profiles
- Save/load keybinds instantly
- Switch profiles in-game with a hotkey
- Auto-switch profiles per world/server
- Import/export profiles for sharing
- Clean and simple GUI
- Lightweight with minimal performance impact

---

🎮 How to Use

- Press B to open the KeyProfiles menu (default key — can be changed)
- Or go to Options → Controls → KeyProfiles
- Create a new profile from your current keybinds
- Switch profiles anytime in-game
- Profiles can auto-switch based on world/server

---

🖼️ Preview

«Check the Gallery tab for all screenshots and visuals.»

---

📋 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

---

🚀 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader
2. Add Fabric API to "mods" folder
3. Add KeyProfiles to "mods" folder
4. Launch the game

---

❓ FAQ

Works with other mods?
Yes, supports all keybinds.

Client-side?
Yes, no server install needed.
